profile.summary: cope demonstrates strong foundational JavaScript skills focused on utility function development within the Lodash ecosystem. Their contributions primarily involve proposing new utility functions (e.g., `titleCase`, `sentenceCase`) and improving documentation through research-backed examples. While their PRs show deep familiarity with Lodash’s design patterns and string manipulation techniques, they lack evidence of modern JavaScript frameworks, backend systems, or testing practices. Their experience appears to be concentrated in library-level utility development rather than full-stack or application-level work. The developer exhibits good GitHub collaboration practices but has not yet implemented actual code changes, suggesting they are in the early stages of contributing to open-source projects.
